name: What types of materials are used for trim and molding?

mainEntity.name: What types of materials are used for trim and molding?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common materials for trim and molding include solid wood (such as pine, oak, or maple), MDF (medium-density fiberboard), and PVC. Solid wood offers natural beauty and durability, while MDF is more affordable and stable. PVC is ideal for moisture-prone areas like bathrooms due to its water resistance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Trim and molding materials include solid wood, MDF, and PVC, each with distinct benefits for appearance, cost, and moisture resistance.
